work_order_assignee_state.name: work_order_assignee_state
work_order_assignee_state.value:
("work_orders"."status" = 'PENDING' AND "work_orders"."responsible_membership_id" IS NULL
      AND "work_orders"."assignment_version" = 0)
    OR ("work_orders"."status" = 'ASSIGNED' AND "work_orders"."responsible_membership_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND "work_orders"."assignment_version" >= 1)
    OR ("work_orders"."status" NOT IN ('PENDING', 'ASSIGNED')
      AND "work_orders"."assignment_version" >= 0)

work_order_event_incident_transition.name: work_order_event_incident_transition
work_order_event_incident_transition.value:
("work_order_events"."from_incident_status" IS NULL AND "work_order_events"."to_incident_status" IS NULL)
    OR ("work_order_events"."from_incident_status" IS NOT NULL
      AND "work_order_events"."to_incident_status" IS NOT NULL
      AND "work_order_events"."from_incident_status" = 'UNDER_REVIEW'
      AND "work_order_events"."to_incident_status" = 'IN_PROGRESS')

work_order_assignment_transition.name: work_order_assignment_transition
work_order_assignment_transition.value:
(
    ("work_order_assignments"."action" = 'ASSIGNED' AND "work_order_assignments"."from_membership_id" IS NULL
      AND "work_order_assignments"."version" = 1)
    OR ("work_order_assignments"."action" = 'REASSIGNED' AND "work_order_assignments"."from_membership_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND "work_order_assignments"."version" >= 2)
  ) AND "work_order_assignments"."from_membership_id" IS DISTINCT FROM "work_order_assignments"."to_membership_id"

work_order_assignment_reason_length.name: work_order_assignment_reason_length
work_order_assignment_reason_length.value: "work_order_assignments"."reason" IS NULL OR length("work_order_assignments"."reason") BETWEEN 3 AND 500

work_order_execution_transition.name: work_order_execution_transition
work_order_execution_transition.value:
(
    ("work_order_executions"."action" = 'STARTED' AND "work_order_executions"."from_status" = 'ASSIGNED'
      AND "work_order_executions"."to_status" = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND "work_order_executions"."result" IS NULL)
    OR ("work_order_executions"."action" = 'COMPLETED' AND "work_order_executions"."from_status" = 'IN_PROGRESS'
      AND "work_order_executions"."to_status" = 'COMPLETED'
      AND length("work_order_executions"."result") BETWEEN 10 AND 4000)
  )

incident_closure_consistency.name: incident_closure_consistency
incident_closure_consistency.value:
"incident_closures"."order_count" >= 0 AND "incident_closures"."completed_count" >= 0
      AND "incident_closures"."cancelled_count" >= 0
      AND "incident_closures"."completed_count" + "incident_closures"."cancelled_count" = "incident_closures"."order_count"
      AND length("incident_closures"."reason") BETWEEN 10 AND 1000
      AND (( "incident_closures"."order_count" = 0 AND "incident_closures"."from_status" = 'UNDER_REVIEW'
        AND "incident_closures"."conclusion" IS NULL)
      OR ("incident_closures"."order_count" > 0 AND "incident_closures"."from_status" = 'IN_PROGRESS'
        AND length("incident_closures"."conclusion") BETWEEN 20 AND 4000))
